nodes.summary: Let $\ell$ be a natural number. A function $F : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}$ is an $\ell$-generalized Fibonacci sequence when $F(n) = 0$ for every integer $n$ with $2 - \ell \le n \le 0$, $F(1) = 1$, and $F(n) = \sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} F(n-1-i)$ for every integer $n > 1$.
nodes.title: ℓ-generalized Fibonacci sequence

nodes.summary: For $\ell = 2$ the characteristic polynomial $\varphi_2$ of the $\ell$-generalized Fibonacci recurrence is the Fibonacci polynomial $X^2 - X - 1$ in $\mathbb{C}[X]$.
nodes.title: The ℓ-generalized Fibonacci characteristic polynomial for ℓ = 2

nodes.summary: For a natural number $\ell$, the characteristic polynomial of the $\ell$-generalized Fibonacci recurrence is the polynomial $\varphi_\ell(X) = X^\ell - \sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} X^i$ in $\mathbb{C}[X]$; for $\ell \ge 2$ this is $X^\ell - X^{\ell-1} - \cdots - X - 1$.
nodes.title: Characteristic polynomial of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci recurrence

nodes.summary: For a natural number $\ell$ and a complex number $\beta$, the Dresden–Du coefficient is the complex number $c(\beta) = \frac{\beta - 1}{2 + (\ell + 1)(\beta - 2)}$, taken to be $0$ when the denominator vanishes.
nodes.title: Dresden–Du coefficient

nodes.summary: For a natural number $\ell$ and a real number $\alpha$, this is the finite set of distinct complex roots of the characteristic polynomial $\varphi_\ell(X) = X^\ell - \sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} X^i$ other than $\alpha$. In applications $\alpha$ is the dominant real root of $\varphi_\ell$.
nodes.title: Other roots of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci characteristic polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $\ell \ge 2$, let $\alpha > 1$ be a real number with $\alpha^\ell = \sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} \alpha^i$, and let $k$ be a natural number divisible by $\ell - 1$; write $q = k/(\ell - 1)$. nodes.title: Explicit possible poles of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci zeta function

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $\ell$ and $k$, a real number $\alpha$ and an integer $n$, let $q$ be the quotient of $k$ by $\ell - 1$ in natural-number division, with $q = 0$ when $\ell \le 1$ (so $q = k/(\ell - 1)$ when $\ell \ge 2$ and $\ell - 1$ divides $k$). nodes.title: Corollary pole of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci zeta function

nodes.summary: Let $\ell \ge 2$, let $F$ be an $\ell$-generalized Fibonacci sequence, let $\alpha > 1$ be a real number with $\alpha^\ell = \sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} \alpha^i$, and let $S$ be the set of possible poles determined by $\ell$ and $\alpha$. nodes.title: Meromorphic continuation of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci zeta function

nodes.summary: Let $\ell \ge 2$, let $F$ be an $\ell$-generalized Fibonacci sequence, let $\alpha > 1$ be a real number with $\alpha^\ell = \sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1} \alpha^i$, and let $S$ be the set of possible poles determined by $\ell$ and $\alpha$. nodes.title: Rational values of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci zeta function at negative integers

nodes.title: Set of possible poles of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci zeta function

nodes.summary: For every natural number $\ell$ and every real number $\alpha$, the possible pole $s_{\kappa,n}$ of the $\ell$-generalized Fibonacci zeta function indexed by the identically zero function $\kappa$ and $n = 0$ equals $0$.
nodes.title: The possible pole at the zero index is zero

nodes.title: Residue expression of the ℓ-generalized Fibonacci zeta function

nodes.summary: Let $\ell \ge 2$ and let $F$ be an $\ell$-generalized Fibonacci sequence. For every complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 0$, the series $\sum_{n \ge 1} |F_n^{-s}|$ converges, where $F_n^{-s}$ is the principal complex power of $F_n$ viewed as a complex number.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
